Lower Text: [Security] You may play 1 level 4 or lower green or black [TS] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
Upper Text: While you have no face-up security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
{Security} [Your Turn] All of your green or black [TS] trait Digimon gain ＜Alliance＞. While you have [Bacchusmon] or [Ceresmon], they also gain ＜Piercing＞.

[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand and place this card face up as the bottom security card. Then, you may play 1 green or black [TS] trait Digimon card from your hand with the cost reduced by 3.
